JOB DESCRIPTION
**Our Company**
Changing the world through digital experiences is what Adobe’s all about. We give everyone—from emerging artists to global brands—everything they need to design and deliver exceptional digital experiences! We’re passionate about empowering people to create beautiful and powerful images, videos, and apps, and transform how companies interact with customers across every screen.
We’re on a mission to hire the very best and are committed to creating exceptional employee experiences where everyone is respected and has access to equal opportunity. We realize that new ideas can come from everywhere in the organization, and we know the next big idea could be yours!
## The Opportunity
Join Adobe as an Enterprise Sales Account Manager in Thailand and bring your talent to a company that values innovation and growth. This is an outstanding chance to be part of a world-class team that drives outstanding digital experiences. At Adobe, you'll have the opportunity to compete in a dynamic market, work with ambitious goals, and make a significant impact on our success!
## What you'll Do
* Develop and implement strategic sales plans to achieve revenue targets
* Identify and penetrate new markets, while maintaining and growing existing accounts
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver flawless customer experiences
* Provide world-class solutions by understanding customer needs and determining the best Adobe products to meet them
* Successfully implement sales strategies and track progress through detailed reporting
## What you need to succeed
* Degree or equivalent experience with 5+ years of practical experience
* Proven track record in enterprise sales, preferably within the software industry
* Strong negotiation and communication skills
* Ability to work independently and as part of a collaborative team
* Determined and approach focused
